author: Bryan Smith
text: Someone mentioned that the first few b's were at prime number indices (2,3,5,7,...). Go counter clockwise and mark each prime index with blue or yellow and you'll see that yellow prime indices take up two spaces with be. Removing one of those letters makes everything line up again. If a=1, b=2, etc. be=25 and y (yellow) is the 25th letter. I don't know how relevant this is since this breaks down after the 20th prime, but the 20th prime index is where the magic white fefefe square is.
